title: Closing thanks to Collier, Cook, Mikell and Jenkins
summary: Briggs thanks the Smithsonian, Rutgers and Collier, and credits Will Marion Cook, Eugene Mikell and Edmund Jenkins for all they did for him.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I'm very grateful and thankful to the Smithsonian and Rutgers Institutes, who are interested in my professional activities and life. I have

been aided and helped by Mr. James Collier whom I think is a very, very fine person. Very capable reporter. And a musician in addition. He has all of the qualities that I think a person should have, and I'm very very grateful, again, I keep on repeating it.
I also thank three persons. Will Marion Cook, Eugene Mikell, and Edmund Jenkins for all that they've done for me. And I would like to say, 'God Bless You All'.
